subject: Next step: 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — proposed times + draft agenda
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@helmtech.io>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Next step: 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — proposed times + draft agenda

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to understand HelmTech's latency targets and the constraint around on-prem data routing. To keep momentum, we'd like to lock a 60–90 minute technical deep dive that includes your ML and infra leads so we can:

- Walk through your current serving topology and inference bottlenecks
- Validate model compatibility (quantization / distillation constraints)
- Review networking and VPC requirements for Private deployment
- Agree on a mutual action plan and required artifacts for procurement

Can you confirm whether the following windows work for your team (all ET):

- Tue Nov 2: 14:00–15:30
- Wed Nov 3: 11:00–12:30

If neither works, send a couple of alternatives — we can be flexible. Please also confirm the attendee roster (we expect at least one ML lead + one infra/ops owner). I attached a short PDF of today's discovery notes for reference.

Draft agenda attached as docx — Naomi (solutions), would you and Karthik (ML infra) be available to join? Karthik, we may hand the deep dive infra portion to you — anything you want on the agenda that I should add?

Thanks,

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0148
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20261030-discovery-notes.pdf
From: Elena Rossi <elena@helmtech.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 15:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next step: 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — proposed times + draft agenda

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the recap and the clear agenda. Both slots look doable but I need to confirm with Marco (CTO) and Priya (ML lead). Quick answers to your asks:

Attendees we expect:
- Elena Rossi — Head of Product
- Marco Santini — CTO
- Priya Shah — Lead ML Engineer
- One of our site reliability engineers (TBD)

Priority topics for us (please make sure these are front-loaded in the agenda):
1) Model compatibility: we use a mix of Llama-family and a proprietary encoder stack — want to verify quantization and KV-cache behavior
2) Data handling & retention: specifics around request logs, audit retention, and how Redwood surfaces those for SOC2 evidence
3) Network topology: we need to understand the VPC peering options and any egress patterns that could affect our infra costs

I also prefer Wed Nov 3 11:00–12:30 ET if that slot remains open. Sharing a short calendar link here: https://cal.com/helmtech/tdx-propose — I'll lock attendees once Marco confirms.

Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Product, HelmTech
elena@helmtech.io

Subject: Re: Next step: 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — proposed times + draft agenda

Great — thanks for confirming the attendee roles and priorities, Elena. Wed Nov 3 11:00–12:30 ET is reserved on our side; I'll send a calendar invite once you lock attendees.

I've updated the attached agenda draft to put model compatibility and data handling first (see tdx-agenda-draft.docx). Proposed agenda (high level):

0) 5 min quick intros / goals
1) 25–30 min: serving topology + latency profile (HelmTech presents)
2) 20–25 min: Redwood replicate — model compatibility, quantization, and inference tradeoffs (Karthik lead)
3) 15 min: networking & security options (VPC peering, private control plane)
4) 10 min: rollout plan / mutual action items + procurement artifact checklist

Pre-reads: short discovery notes (attached) and our one-pager on Private deployment connectivity: https://drive.redwood.com/priv-connect-onepager (internal link).

HubSpot: I updated the deal record with the slot + priorities: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HT-4821 — Elena, if you want me to add Marco's email to the record I can.

Naomi — will you own the attendee-facing invite and pre-read packet? Karthik — would you like a short tech pre-call (30m) with Priya prior to the session to align on model artifacts we should request?

If Wed 11:00 ET is final, I'll drop the invite and include the agenda + attachments.

- Marcus
